summary: First test run for Verdant Salary Budgeting app. Ran 19 backend pytest cases and 4 Playwright UI flows. All 19 backend tests passed (auth, budget settings, transactions CRUD, goals CRUD, dashboard, Claude advisor). All UI flows passed: login as admin -> dashboard, create expense transaction, create goal + +50 contribute, Budget page preset 50/30/20 + sum-validation disables Save when != 100, Sage AI advisor returns a meaningful Claude reply, logout returns to /login.

issues: A11y console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' — add a DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) inside each Radix DialogContent.

action_items: (Nice-to-have) Add <DialogDescription> to DialogContent in Transactions.jsx and Goals.jsx to silence Radix a11y warning.

(Nice-to-have) /api/dashboard 'balance' field has an odd ternary: returns (income + salary - expenses) only when income == 0, otherwise (income - expenses). It is functionally redundant with 'net' but inconsistent — consider removing 'balance' or aligning it with 'net' (salary + income - expenses).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py — CORS uses a single explicit origin via FRONTEND_URL with allow_credentials=True (correct for the preview). Good.
server.py — bcrypt hashing with $2b$ format used; JWT signed via HS256 with JWT_SECRET from env. Good.
server.py — Mongo _id is correctly excluded everywhere (projection {'_id':0} and .pop()).
server.py — Income transactions are forced to bucket='income' server-side (defensive). Good.
server.py — Budget settings PUT validates needs+wants+savings == 100 (400 otherwise). Good.

server.py — Dashboard 'balance' field is computed with a conditional (income==0 path uses salary, else not) which makes the value semantically ambiguous; prefer using only 'net' = salary + income - expenses.

server.py — Admin seeding only runs when admin email not present. Password update on env change is not propagated to existing admin — acceptable for now since credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md match the seeded default.
Frontend — JWT stored in localStorage + attached via axios interceptor, plus httpOnly cookie set on login. Both auth paths work as verified by /auth/me with Bearer header in pytest.
Frontend — Dialogs missing DialogDescription (Radix a11y warning).
test_credentials: admin@budget.app / admin123 (seeded). New users registered with TEST_ prefix during test run.
seed_data_creation: Tests create disposable users (TEST_user_*@example.com), TEST_ transactions, and TEST_UI* goals via the API and UI. No production-shape data is touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core features verified end-to-end. data-testids exist on every key element: login-*, register-*, nav-* (dashboard/transactions/budget/goals/advisor), logout-button, open-add-transaction, tx-{type-select,amount-input,category-select,bucket-select,date-input,note-input,submit-button}, open-add-goal, goal-{name-input,target-input,saved-input,deadline-input,submit-button}, add50-{id}/add100-{id}/sub50-{id}, preset-50-30-20/60-20-20/40-30-30, pct-{needs,wants,savings,total}, budget-salary-input, budget-currency-select, budget-save-button, advisor-input, advisor-send-button, starter-0..3. Backend advisor endpoint used by UI is POST /api/advisor/ask (non-streaming) — confirmed returning real Claude replies in ~5-10s.
rca of the issue: No bugs encountered. Only a minor Radix a11y warning (missing DialogDescription) which does not break functionality.
